scope: Cultivar-aware point assessments, separate from unchanged v3.0 global raster. No spatial bias correction from isolated events.
weather_qc: GHCN-Daily TMIN/TMAX: omit -9999 and nonblank quality flags. Retain measurement/source flags. Daily records cannot be called hourly chill observations. No gap filling.
completeness: Annual minimum is a lower-bound exposure statement unless >=95% of calendar days have accepted TMIN. An observed value can demonstrate cold exposure despite incomplete coverage; missing days cannot demonstrate safety.
chill: Published DMA requirements: Arbequina 339, Leccino 612, Frantoio 671 CU (Aybar et al. 2015 Table 2). CU are model-specific, not hours <7.2 or <12.5 C. No transferable CU requirement is supplied for Arbosana or Koroneiki. Do not infer CU from seasonal means or incomplete daily series.
hawaii: Use observed cultivar outcomes and published on-site hourly summaries as conditional fruiting evidence, not a universal 141-hour requirement or proof of economic annual yield.
freeze: Use source-study event minima as local event values; keep nearby station checks separate with distances and elevations. Single events do not replace 35-year gridded statistics.
validation: Exclude the three development sites from remaining regional compatibility metrics. Keep every v3 result and discrepancy; report presentation fixes separately from predictive validation.
